title: How to Research a Stock Without Reading Everything
summary: How to research stocks in a focused order: the business, its numbers, valuation, competitors and risks, then verify the story in SEC filings. A free beginner checklist.
body_markdown:
## Sources and further reading


Checked October 28, 2026. Community posts and videos are included as perspectives; official sources carry the factual authority.


1. [How to Read a 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/answers/reada10k.htm)


U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission · regulator


Business, risk factors, management discussion, financial statements, and the SEC's role.


2. [Using EDGAR to Research Investments](https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-search-assistance/using-edgar-research-investments)


U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission · regulator


How to locate and use company filings in EDGAR.


3. [Beginners’ Guide to Financial Statements](https://www.sec.gov/about/reports-publications/beginners-guide-financial-statements)


U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission · regulator


Income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, shareholders’ equity, footnotes, MD&A, and ratio context.


4. [Analyzing Analyst Recommendations](https://www.sec.gov/about/reports-publications/investorpubsanalystshtm)


U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission · regulator


Warns against relying solely on an analyst recommendation for a buy, hold, or sell decision and identifies possible conflicts.


5. [Asset Allocation and Diversification](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/getting-started/asset-allocation)


Investor.gov · government


Time horizon, risk tolerance, diversification, rebalancing, and limits of narrowly focused funds.


6. [How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/general-resources/news-alerts/alerts-bulletins/investor-bulletins/updated)


Investor.gov · government


The compounding effect of ongoing fees and where to find fee disclosures.


7. [Five Questions to Ask Before You Invest](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y72iyLPOv8E)


PBS Two Cents · video


Transcript reviewed for goal, horizon, risk, cost, and understanding checks.
